Review Telegram 4.7?

Reviewers mostly see Telegram 4.7 as a fast, convenient messaging app that works especially well for groups, channels, media sharing, and keeping busy chats organized with folders, archives, and stickers. Several call it better than WhatsApp or their daily go-to for personal and business use. The main complaints are slower file transfers, distracting Stories, and moderation issues like spam, scammers, and sex bots; one user also questions message deletion controls. Founders of products like Notify.domains praise it as a lightweight, instant notification channel with an easy bot setup.

results.title: Telegram is rated "Bad" with 1.4 / 5 on Trustpilot
results.content:
Looking at 116 reviews, most reviewers were let down by their experience overall. Many people experienced extremely frustrating issues with account security, hacked profiles, and broken login loops, while customer support completely failed to provide any help or response. Users also heavily complained about rampant spam, widespread online scams, and unexpected account bans occurring without proper oversight or human moderation. Though some reviewers were happy with the platform, praising it as a fast, highly functional, and effective messenger for daily personal and business communication. Some consumers also pointed out that the application offers a truly great and smooth experience across different platforms without encountering any annoying technical problems.See more [...] ## Terrible account recovery and security…
Terrible account recovery and security experience  
My Telegram account was compromised and the experience of trying to regain control of it was extremely stressful and frustrating.  
The attacker was able to use my account to send scam messages to my contacts, while I repeatedly found myself locked out. Even though I had two-factor authentication and a recovery email enabled, I could not simply regain control of my own account and terminate the suspicious session.
